# Zaco Labs

> A software studio crafting small but solid products. We build software that takes small frictions out of daily life and work.

Zaco Labs is a small software studio that starts from frictions we have run into ourselves. We build only what is needed, and we stand behind what we build for the long haul. Contact: zaco.labs@gmail.com

## Products

- [Waky](https://zacolabs.github.io/waky-landing/introduce/en/): An alarm you turn off by solving a mission, alarm sounds you record yourself, and morning habits. Free on iOS and Android.
- [Dayline](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/en/): An automatic travel log that draws your day as a line. Your movement record is stored on your device, and only the line of a day you choose to post is shared with others. Free on iOS and Android.
- [Google Maps Timeline alternative | Dayline](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/en/google-timeline-alternative/): Google Maps Timeline now lives only on your phone. Dayline is a free, automatic travel log that draws each day as a line and keeps it on your device.
- [Dayline privacy policy](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/privacy.en.html): what Dayline collects and what never leaves the device
- [Dayline terms of service](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/terms.en.html)
- [Dayline community rules](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/community.en.html): what may be posted to the feed of days, reporting and blocking
- Dayline in other languages: [한국어](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/ko/), [日本語](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/ja/), [简体中文](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/zh-hans/), [繁體中文](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/zh-hant/), [Español](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/es/), [Français](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/fr/), [Deutsch](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/de/), [Italiano](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/it/), [Português](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/pt/), [Nederlands](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/nl/), [Dansk](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/da/), [Polski](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/pl/), [Русский](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/ru/), [العربية](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/ar/), [Bahasa Indonesia](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/id/), [Tiếng Việt](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/vi/), [Filipino](https://zacolabs.github.io/dayline/fil/)
- [Cat Captain (냥반장)](https://zacolabs.github.io/catcaptain/): Snap a stray cat on your walk and it recognizes whether it is one already in your collection. Check in each time you meet, and build a neighborhood cat collection with your neighbors. In Korea only; the page is in Korean. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/kr/app/id6824216133); Android coming soon. [Privacy policy](https://zacolabs.github.io/catcaptain/privacy.html).
- Cat in Room: Pomodoro timer with your cat. Focus for 25 minutes while your cat sits on the chair beside you, then rest for 5. Stay to the end and your cat leaves you a fish. For Android and iOS. Coming soon.
- [8 Billion](https://zacolabs.github.io/8billion/): A life simulation game. Be born in a random country and era, and live one whole life from your first moments to the story you leave behind. For Android and iOS. Coming soon. [한국어](https://zacolabs.github.io/8billion/ko/). [日本語](https://zacolabs.github.io/8billion/ja/). [简体中文](https://zacolabs.github.io/8billion/zh-hans/). [繁體中文](https://zacolabs.github.io/8billion/zh-hant/). [Privacy policy](https://zacolabs.github.io/8billion/privacy.html).
- [DUIRE](https://www.duire.kr/en): We meet Google Play's closed testing requirement of 12 testers for 14 days with real Android devices, and keep every daily run in a final report.
- [Store Bridge](https://bridge.duire.kr/en): A free tool by DUIRE that makes one short link for Google Play and the App Store, sending each visitor to the store for their device.
